jobs.prompt: Bug in laneIdleReasons (tools/board-data.mjs), seen on the live board: with Codex and Cursor both idle and both having run jobs in the last 24h, Codex says 'no ready jobs; recent jobs named Cursor explicitly' AND Cursor says 'no ready jobs; recent jobs named Codex explicitly' — contradictory. Fix rule (h): append '; recent jobs named <other> explicitly' only when THIS label's agents finished 0 jobs in the last 24h (recent jobs === 0) AND the other label (Codex<->Cursor) finished at least 1 job with explicit >= jobs/2. Otherwise the text stays 'no ready jobs'. Change nothing else. Update tests/lane-idle.test.mjs: both lanes with recent jobs -> both plain 'no ready jobs'; Cursor 0 recent + Codex 3 explicit -> Cursor's text ends with 'recent jobs named Codex explicitly' and Codex's stays plain. Edit only tools/board-data.mjs and tests/lane-idle.test.mjs. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/lane-idle.test.mjs tests/board-page.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. ignoreTests cover unrelated board-data behavior; the coordinator runs the full suite.
